questions.title: Enterprise value to equity value (example)
questions.prompt: How do you get from enterprise value to equity value?
answer: Start from enterprise value. Subtract net debt (debt less cash) and other claims on the business, such as preferred stock and non-controlling interest.
What remains is the value attributable to common shareholders.

formulas.label: Equity value
formulas.expression: Enterprise value − net debt − preferred stock − non-controlling interest
